title: The extremal 3/4 conjecture for fix-free code extension constants
statement:
Let $P_\gamma$ denote the property that every relevant partial fix-free code whose Kraftsum is at most $\gamma$ can be extended in the manner defined in the survey; let $\gamma^*$ be the supremum of the values of $\gamma$ for which this property holds. **Extremal extension conjecture.**

$$
\sup_{\gamma\ \text{fulfill }}\gamma=\frac{3}{4}.
$$

The survey establishes that some $\gamma\in[\frac12,\frac34]$ satisfies the property and that no $\gamma>\frac34$ does, leaving the exact supremum as the conjectural part.
source_name: Holger Schnettler, “On the 3/4-Conjecture for Fix-Free Codes – A Survey”, arXiv:0709.2598 (2007).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0709.2598

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2007).
